facts.text: William Carey University operates the College of Osteopathic Medicine, established to train primary care physicians for rural and underserved areas.

sources.title: About Us | College of Osteopathic Medicine | William Carey University
sources.quote: The Mission of the WCUCOM is to prepare men and women to become osteopathic physicians through an emphasis on primary care, lifelong learning, research and scholarly activities, service, including osteopathic clinical service, and graduate medical education.
